review.title: Analysesiden, runde 2
review.intro: Revised analysis page after round 1. Every tab at desktop (1200 px) and phone (375 px). Fjordkode AS and all peers are invented; peer names were not checked against the register. Tokens, markers and number formats are as decided. Better-to-the-right mirroring and the beste-fjerdedel triangle are still provisional. Hover any dot or line for a tooltip; tabs inside the frames are static except where noted.
review.ov.note: Card grid: hero, explanation, three small cards, two peer-plot variants to pick from, compact peer list, sparklines with a faint peer-median line (decided: open to everyone). On the phone the beeswarm shows one tooltip drawn open.
review.pe.note: Default size band, two peers excluded by the user (greyed, can be put back). Comparability has no loosen control. The widened state follows below.
review.gap.note: Desktop frame is signed in, so 'Margin eller kapitalbruk?' opens with content. The phone frame is anonymous: the expanded Totalkapitalrentabilitet row shows the same fold-out behind the account wall.
review.ut.note: Anonymous wall, then the signed-in view in both modes. The figure selector and the mode toggle are live inside each signed-in frame. Desktop shows Driftsmargin (API figure, so 2022 is present); the phone shows Lønnskostnadsandel, where 2022 failed reconciliation and the line breaks.
review.ut.multi: Signed in · all as small multiples
review.ve.note: Rendered at 50 %. The step buttons and the multiple field are live. 'Til medianen' is its own step: disabled for Fjordkode, selectable in the below-median state.
review.ve.below: State: company below the median (other invented company)
